text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Thank you kindly, miss... for guiding me 
all the way here...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right. Just leave it to 
everyone's mascot, Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Asdon... Could you speak up just a little, 
please?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This exchange repeated for a while, and 
Aston Machan grew thoroughly exhausted 
from continuing to shout at the top of her 
lungs, something she rarely did.
